title: LFU Cache
description: Design and implement a data structure for a Least Frequently Used (LFU) cache. Implement the LFUCache class with get and put methods. When the cache reaches its capacity, it should invalidate and remove the least frequently used key before inserting a new item. When there is a tie, the least recently used key is evicted.
